movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Rhythmic clapping around the central lamp, holding artificial sword and shield during Parichamuttukali
movement_profile.footwork: Circular stepping patterns around a central point
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circle around a lit Nilavilakku brass lamp on the floor
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to medium stance; jumps not described in sources
movement_profile.partnering: Group circular formation; individual partner interactions not described in sources
movement_profile.posture: Upright posture with gentle knee Bends during circular movements

signature_moves.description: Circular group stepping and clapping around a lit brass oil lamp representing Christ
signature_moves.name: Nilavilakku step

signature_moves.description: Martial play section incorporating artificial swords and shields
signature_moves.name: Parichamuttukali segment

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid disruptive movements near the lit oil lamp.

music_profile.musical_form: Two-part performance (padham) of 14 stanzas followed by martial accompaniment
music_profile.sound_description: A lead vocal narrative chanting 14 stanzas in Middle Tamil and Syriac devotional terms, punctuated solely by the metallic rhythmic strike of a pair of small, palm-sized cymbals without external drums or melodic instruments.
music_profile.vocal_style: Vocal narration in 14 stanzas blending Middle Tamil and Syriac liturgical terms

basic_steps: Circular walking step maintaining equal spacing around the central lamp
Rhythmic hand clapping in unison with vocal refrain
Side-stepping and light knee bends synchronized to cymbal meter
Martial defensive stance with artificial sword and shield during the second phase
teaching.formation: Circular round dance around a lit Nilavilakku
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on circular group synchronization and hand claps before moving to martial shield movements.
teaching.rhythm: Set by vocal chanting and palm-sized cymbals
